findings.title: Readiness accepts an incomplete port at a stdout chunk boundary
findings.origin: Inherited relative to HEAD: the same unanchored URL regex existed before this cleanup change. Not introduced by optimisation.
findings.impact: Dummy local provider harness can resolve a truncated root URL and fail its subsequent local requests. Pipe data chunks have no line-boundary guarantee. This is a test startup reliability weakness, not a production transport finding.
findings.reachability: Provider startup prints one readiness line; OS stdout events may split after some port digits. No actual split observed from Python in this review.
findings.faithfulReproduction: verification-current-repro.mjs evaluates the exact current launch helper with an owned fake EventEmitter child. Emit http://127.0.0.1:12, then 345 newline. launch returns port 12 rather than 12345. Fake stop closes and all fake timers are cleared.
findings.smallestFix: Only parse complete newline-terminated readiness lines, preserving a bounded incomplete suffix until the next chunk. Add this exact split-output fixture.

findings.title: Disposing a test client leaves pending request timers active
findings.origin: Inherited relative to HEAD: request timer/map and dispose forwarding are unchanged by startup fixes.
findings.impact: After an earlier assertion fails with a request pending, fixture disposal aborts adapter work but leaves its wrapper promise/timer pending for up to ten seconds. Failed or suppressed requests retain waiting entries until the helper is collected. No persistent production leak shown.
findings.reachability: Failure cleanup during an outstanding request, or a deliberately cancelled request whose adapter suppresses its reply. Normal integration path awaits each request, so that path is not affected.
findings.faithfulReproduction: Exact current client helper evaluated with fake adapter and recorded timers. Start Configure, dispose client. Adapter dispose runs but one ten-second timeout remains; firing that fake timer rejects the still-pending request. No wall-clock wait or real request.
findings.smallestFix: Store timer and reject function for each waiting entry; on timeout delete the entry, and on dispose clear timers, reject pending requests, and clear the map before adapter disposal.
